The hobby or interest name is semantic context only and must never appear visually. Never render the hobby name, title, subtitle, caption, heading, label, footer, explanatory copy, poster copy, body copy, text box, lower-third, or typography-like decoration. Treat every monitor, laptop, tablet, phone, camera display, dashboard, terminal, and digital panel as a physical prop rather than a semantic canvas. Prefer no visible screen surface at all. Recognition must come from the person, physical tool, device, prototype, controller, camera, microphone, hardware, object, or real-world action.
